title: Crayon Shin-chan
justification: From AniDB 344 on TVDB 79654's absolute numbers are missing or shifted (TVDB S9E31 Futaba Angel / I Want to Get an Allowance carries abs 387 and is AniDB 374 Futaba Angel / Okozukai o Moraitaizo, both 2000-10-20), so each AniDB episode is placed by its air date, which matches one TVDB episode for 965 of 972 episodes from 374 on, and by title where SkyHook's date is off: S15E27 I'm 2 Years Old / Episode 579B is 579 Ora 2-saiji Dazo, so S15E25-31 (Episode 577-583) are 577-583; S19E15 Kazama-kun's Hair Is...! is 703 Kazama-kun no Kami ga... Dazo and S19E16 Rock Soul is 704 Rock Tamashii Dazo; S19E33 Episode 721 (2010-12-10) is 721, whose AniDB date 2010-03-12 is transposed; S26E21 Mermaid Legend of Mystery is 938 Nazo no Ningyo Densetsu and S26E22 A Penguin Arrived / Beaten Rabbit is 939 Penguin ga Kitazo / Nagurare Usagi; S24E24-25 Episode 871-872 keep TVDB's own counter like the rest of season 24. From 1048 on TVDB's Episode N counter runs ahead of AniDB's by one to eighteen while every weekly air date matches, so the date wins; S28E14 Cooking with Miss Nanako is 996 by title. Before 344 the absolute default holds except 167 Kareha no Souji (S4E14 Cleaning up dead leaves) and 169 Ikari no Beni Sasori Tai (S4E16 Angry Red Scorpion Group), whose TVDB absolute numbers are swapped. AniDB 1264-1280 are untitled duplicates of 1246-1262 on the same air dates (AniDB's two numberings overlap there) and 1263 (2025-04-24) has no TVDB episode, so they are unmapped. AniDB lists 104 specials, which had no row and defaulted onto TVDB season 0 episodes 1-104 by number, though TVDB lists fewer TV specials and puts the films at episodes 65-115. By date and segment titles: S1-S7 are episodes 1-7 (from "So Many Promises / Making Mochi" 1992-12-28 to "Akachan ga Umareruzo" 1994-12-26); S9-S48 are episodes 8-47, each on the same date with the same segments (S9 "Genshijidai no Shin-chan" = "We see Shin-Chan in prehistory", S24 "Orateki na Hanasaka Jiisan" = "We tell the story of the selfish old man", S32 "Himitsu no Bocchan / Drive wa Dokidoki" = "Boo-chan has a secret / We like to drive"); S50-S51 are 48-49, S53-S54 are 50-51, S55-S57 are 53-55 ("Nohara Shijuurou" = "Shijuro Nohara"), S59-S67 are 56-64, S68 is 67, S69 is 69 ("Suika" = "cool my watermelon"), S70 is 112 ("Shouhizei ga Agaruzo" = "The consumption tax is going up"), S71 is 72 ("Real Omamagoto" = "Real Play-Doh with Michi & Yoshirin"), S74 is 78 ("Suspense on the Bullet Train"), S76-S77 are 113-114, S86 is 110 ("All Masao Dai Shingeki Special"). S81, the film release commemoration special with "Buriburizaemon no Bouken" (2020-09-12, the film having been postponed from April), is episode 107 "Movie Release Commemoration Buriburizaemon Special" (dated 2020-04-04); S85, the ninja special for the 2022 ninja film (2022-04-23), is episode 109 "Movie Release Commemoration: Ninja Training Special" (2022-04-16), the only special of each kind. S8, S49, S52, S58, S72, S73, S75, S78-S80, S82-S84, S87-S99 (later TV specials) and S100-S104 (bloopers and extras) have no TVDB episode and are unmapped.
